title: llm-d P/D Disaggregation — Latency by Stage (g6 / L4)
description: Latency across four stages: EPP → Prefill → NIXL KV transfer → Decode. Based on vLLM V1 / llm-d 1.x metrics.

list.name: prefill_pod
list.label: Prefill pod regex
list.description: Regex for prefill pod names. Adjust to the llm-d deployment name.

list.name: gpu_node
list.label: GPU node instance regex
list.description: node_exporter instance label (e.g. ip-10-0-1-23.*). Narrow to the g6 nodes running prefill/decode.

list.name: net_dev
list.label: Network interface regex
list.description: ENA interface name on g6 nodes (RHCOS default ens5, etc.).

panels.title: E2E latency p95 (EPP)
panels.description: llm_d_epp_request_duration_seconds — from request receipt to response completion.

panels.title: TTFT p95 (EPP)
panels.description: Time to first token as seen by the user. Includes routing + prefill + KV transfer + first decode step.

panels.title: ITL p95 (Decode)
panels.description: Inter-token latency on the decode pod.

panels.title: NIXL transfer failures/s
panels.description: Non-zero means KV transfers are failing; check kv_load_failure_policy behaviour (decode recomputes the prompt and still returns 200).

panels.title: P/D routing decisions
panels.description: Share of decode-only vs prefill-decode. Matches both upstream llm-d (llm_d_epp_disagg_decision_total) and RHOAI 3.x (llm_d_inference_scheduler_disagg_decision_total). Short prompts routed decode-only skew P/D measurements.

targets.expr: sum without (instance, pod, job, endpoint, container, service) (rate({__name__=~"llm_d_epp_disagg_decision_total|llm_d_inference_scheduler_disagg_decision_total", namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p95 by stage (where the time goes)
panels.description: Sidecar prefill − engine prefill ≈ prefill queueing / HTTP overhead. E2E TTFT − sidecar prefill ≈ KV pull + decode scheduling + first step.

panels.title: EPP scheduling latency
panels.description: Time inside the EPP scheduling cycle. Several ms or more: check the scorer/filter plugins.

panels.title: Flow Control queue wait (when flowControl is enabled)
panels.description: Collected only when the flowControl feature gate is on.

panels.title: Plugin latency p95
panels.description: Spot slow scorers/filters. Label names may differ between EPP versions.

panels.title: Pool saturation by stage
panels.description: prefill / decode / effective. Above 1.0, demand exceeds capacity.

panels.title: Prefill engine compute time
panels.description: vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds — pure PREFILL phase time inside the engine.

panels.title: Prefill stage latency (sidecar view)
panels.description: Time the decode pod routing sidecar spends calling the prefill pod. The gap to engine compute time is queueing / network overhead. Requires the sidecar metrics port to be scraped.

panels.title: Prefill queue wait
panels.description: Time spent in scheduler WAITING. If it grows, consider scaling prefill out.

panels.title: Prompt token throughput (prefill TPS)
panels.description: Prompt tokens processed per second.

panels.title: Prefill KV cache usage / prefix cache hit rate
Prefill GPU utilization (DCGM)
panels.description: Prefill is compute-bound, so high SM utilization is expected.

panels.title: Prefill GPU PCIe TX (KV → host staging)
panels.description: g6 (L4) has no NVLink or GPUDirect RDMA, so KV leaves via GPU → host memory → NIC. Prefill-side PCIe TX spikes when decode pulls KV. DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_* must be added to the dcgm-exporter CSV (bytes/s gauge).

panels.title: ③ KV cache transfer (NIXL / node network)
NIXL transfer time (post → done)
panels.description: vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds. One observation per request per TP rank (TP2: two per request). Over 25 Gbps TCP this can be a large share of prefill time.

panels.title: NIXL post (submit) time
panels.description: Synchronous submit phase. If only this is high while transfer time is normal: descriptor preparation / submit overhead.

panels.title: Effective transfer bandwidth (bytes / xfer time)
panels.description: Bandwidth achieved while transferring (rank average). Theoretical cap: 25 Gbps ≈ 3.1 GB/s on the node network. Below 1.5 GB/s, check TCP tuning, same AZ / placement group, and whether in-node transfers bypass the GPU path.

panels.title: Avg size per transfer (per rank)
panels.description: One transfer = one TP rank's share of a request's KV (plus linear-attention state for hybrid models).

panels.title: Avg descriptors per transfer
panels.description: High values point to KV block fragmentation or a small block_size.

panels.title: NIXL failures / expirations
panels.description: Rising KV expired = lease ran out before decode read it: check kv_lease_duration, decode backlog, or failed handshakes (NIXL side channel host).

panels.title: GPU node network TX / RX (ENA)
panels.description: Path carrying NIXL (UCX TCP) KV transfers. Near 25 Gbps ≈ 3.1 GB/s means the network is saturated. Check that prefill-node TX and decode-node RX line up with NIXL transfers.

panels.title: Network congestion signals (TCP retransmits, drops)
panels.description: Rising retransmits blow up NIXL tail latency (p99). ENA allowance overruns (bw_out_allowance_exceeded, etc.) need a separate ethtool-based exporter.

panels.title: ④ Decode scheduling & compute (decode pod, L4)
Inter-Token Latency (ITL)
panels.description: Indicator of decode memory-bandwidth bottlenecks.

panels.title: Decode-side TTFT
panels.description: First token from the decode engine's view. Includes KV pull wait + scheduling + first step.

panels.title: Decode stage latency (sidecar view)
panels.description: Scales with output length; normalize by output tokens when reading it.

panels.title: Decode requests waiting / running
panels.description: Sustained waiting > 0 means not enough KV blocks to receive into, or the concurrency limit.

panels.title: Decode KV cache usage
panels.description: Above 0.9, new KV can't be received and preemption starts.

panels.title: Decode GPU utilization / memory bandwidth (DCGM)
panels.description: Decode normally shows high DRAM active and relatively low SM utilization.

panels.title: Decode GPU PCIe RX (host → KV load)
panels.description: Moving received KV from host buffers onto the GPU.
